value.rationale: A complete equality classification of a natural fourth moment for a nonparabolic finite-field monomial curve determines thirteen four-dimensional phase-torus components at the unique nontrivial Sidon fourth-power image prime p=13, rather than only the already known constant-input energy. The field boundary p=5,13 versus all others follows from a structural counting argument, not an arbitrary computational window; the parameter-specific fact explains precisely when independent quartic-class phases remain invisible to pair-collision constraints.
